init.darwin: node -e "const f=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path'),o=require('node:os');const r=process.env.JIUWENSWARM_DATA_DIR||process.env.JIUWENSWARM_HOME||p.join(o.homedir(),'.jiuwenswarm');const d=['mcp_hub','mcp_builtins'].map(t=>p.join(r,'agent','workspace','mcp',t,'linear')).find(x=>{try{const m=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(p.join(x,'manifest.json'),'utf8'));return m.id==='linear'&&m.version==='1.2.1'}catch{return false}});if(!d){console.error('找不到当前 Linear 安装包，请从卡片重新安装。');process.exit(1)}require(p.join(d,'skills','linear-guide','scripts','linear-cli.cjs')).main(process.argv.slice(1)).catch(()=>{console.error('Linear 操作未完成，请检查连接。');process.exitCode=1})" -- prepare
